name: netproof-wallet
description: Air-gapped hardware wallet built from an offline Android phone (Capacitor) + Chrome extension companion wallet.

scripts.build: NP_BUILD_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) NP_BUILD_TIME=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ) pnpm --filter @netproof/hardware build && pnpm --filter @netproof/companion-web build && pnpm --filter @netproof/extension build
scripts.build:hardware: NP_BUILD_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) NP_BUILD_TIME=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ) pnpm --filter @netproof/hardware build
scripts.build:extension: NP_BUILD_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) NP_BUILD_TIME=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ) pnpm --filter @netproof/extension build
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm -r test && pnpm build
